1084-4279-7192.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-7192.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-7192.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2645-3430-4644-6256.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4644-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=1 that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

4050-5660-6012--35.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=1 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or {1} available otherwise.
4050-5660-6012--35.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying one mana, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4091-5711-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
4091-5711-7791.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Fanatic of Rhonas.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat.

215-2079-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-2079-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1309-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-5189-6627-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-6627-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to The Earth Crystal.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1995-3809-4917-5184.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
1995-3809-4917-5184.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{W} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{W} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
1995-3809-4917-5184.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

57-4235-4846-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-7296.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2113-3713-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

877-4661-6967.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Doppelganger triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

2079-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
2079-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1920-2060-4222-5328-7061.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-4222-5328-7061.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

104-2811-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2811-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-5231-6972--112.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
3773-5231-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

277-774-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have two nonartifact land cards in hand, at least one of which can tap to produce mana.
277-774-2232.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands.
Holding priority, activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3055-5256-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
3055-5256-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2577-2921-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-2921-4871.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

2511-3817-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
2511-3817-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 2.
Repeat.

862-2640-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {W}.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3129-3470-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3129-3470-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3129-3470-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

1116-2324-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-2324-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Proper Burial and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Proper Burial and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

333-2511-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2511-4775.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

184-3883-4365.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-3883-4365.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1895-2562-2992-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Living Lightning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Living Lightning, adding {W}.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Graceful Reprieve trigger.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Graceful Reprieve trigger, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

67-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Reveillark.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reveillark, adding one mana of any color.
When Reveillark dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-3098-3449-3809-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {1}{U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {1}{U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

460-539-1376.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
460-539-1376.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Priest of Titania.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.
